mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in employment levels signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, housing starts falling below 1150 units signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST falls below 1150 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the prior 3 months indicates robust economic output, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 255 signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 255.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and retail sales signals consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market slack regime, a decline in employment levels below 150,000 persons combined with unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating employment conditions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances meeting the trigger condition during labor market slack.
